summary: The above image shows how to simplify a complex rational expression. The example is one-third plus one-sixth divided by one-half minus one-third. Simplify the numerator and denominator. Find the LCD and add the fractions in the numerator. 1 times 2 divided by 3 times 2 plus one-sixth divided by 1 times 3 divided by 2 time 3 minus 1 times 2 divided by 3 times 2. Simplify the numerator and denominator to get two-sixths plus one-sixth divided by three-sixths minus two-sixths. Simplify the numerator and denominator again to get three-sixths divided by one-sixth. Find the LCD and add the fractions in the denominator. Rewrite the complex rational expression as a division problem to get three-sixths divided by one-sixth. Multiply the first by the reciprocal of the second to get three-sixth times 6 divided by 1. Simply to 3.

summary: The above image shows how to simplify a complex rational expression by writing it as division. Simplify n minus 4 n divided by n plus 5 divided by 1 divided by n plus 5 plus 1 divided by n minus 5. Simplify the numerator and denominator. Find common denominators for the numerator and the denominator. We now have n times n plus 5 divided by 1 times n plus 5 minus 4 n divided by n plus 5 divided by 1 times n minus 5 divided by n plus 5 times n minus 5 plus 1 times n plus 5 divided by n minus 5 times n plus 5. Simplify the numerators to get n squared plus 5 n divided by n plus 5 minus 4 n divided by n plus 5 divided by n minus 5 divided by n plus 5 times n minus 5 plus n plus 5 divided by n minus 5 times n plus 5. Subtract the rational expressions in the numerator and add in the denominator. We now have n squared plus 5 n minus 4 n divided by n plus 5 divided by n minus 5 plus n plus 5 divided by n plus times n minus 5. Simplify. (We now have one rational expression over one rational expression.) This gives us n squared plus n divided by n plus 5 divided by 2 n divided n plus 5 times n minus 5.

The LCD of all the fractions in the whole expression is 6. Clear the fractions by multiplying the numerator and denominator by that LCD. We now have 6 times one-third plus one-sixth divided by 6 times one-half minus one-third. Distribute to get 6 times one-third plus 6 times one-sixth divided by 6 times one-half minus 6 times one-third. Simply to get 2 plus 1 divided by 3 minus 2. Simplify, further to 3 divided by 1. Then to 3.

summary: The above image shows the steps on how to simplify a complex rational expression using the LCD. Simplify 2 divided by x plus 6 divided by 4 divided by x minus 6 minus 4 divided by x squared minus 36. Find the LCD of all fractions in the complex rational expression. The LCD is x plus 6 times x minus 6. Multiply the numerator and denominator by the LCD. Multiply the numerator and denominator by the LCD  We have x plus 6 times x minus 6 times 2 divided by x plus 6 divided by x plus 6 times x minus 6 times 4 divided by x minus 6 minus 4 divided by x plus 6 times x minus 6. Simplify the expression. Distribute in the denominator. We now have x plus 6 times x minus 6 times 2 divided by x plus 6 divided by x plus 6 times x minus 6 times 4 divided by x minus 6 minus x plus 6 times x minus 6 times 4 divided by x plus 6 times x minus 6. Simplify. Cross out x plus 6 twice from the numerator. Cross out x minus 6, x minus 6, x plus 6 times x minus 6, then x plus 6 and x minus 6 from the denominator, in that order. Simplify to get 2 times x minus 6 divided by 4 times x plus 6 minus 4. To simplify the denominator, distribute and combine like terms to get 2 times x minus 6 divided by 4 x plus 20. Remove common factors. Cross out 2 from the numerator and denominator. Simplify to x minus 6 divided by 2 times x minus 5. Notice that there are no more factors common to the numerator and denominator.
